description: Benchmarking YOLOv8s-seg against Mask R-CNN for real-time instance segmentation of drill cuttings on shale shakers: measuring segmentation accuracy against inference speed to decide which model fits live deployment.
detailedDescription: As an assistant researcher, I am authoring a follow-up paper comparing YOLOv8s-seg and Mask R-CNN for real-time instance segmentation of drill cuttings, using a different dataset and model setup from the previous YOLOv8 vs Re-DeTR study.
